subject: Cap Product

content: #2 Re #1: The cap product is bilinear, it suffices to define the cap product of a p-simplex σ and a cochain dual to a (p+q)-simplex τ. The result is a q-simplex ρ given by the first (q+1) vertices of τ if the last (p+1) vertex of τ are equal to σ. Otherwise it is 0.
subject: Cap Product
